testo:
Multi
■ While you are summoning this creature, you may destroy any number of your creatures. For each creature destroyed this way, this creature costs 5 less to summon. It can't cost 4 or less.
Speed Attacker
Quattro Breaker
■ Whenever this creature attacks, destroy one of your opponent's light creatures, water creatures, darkness creatures, fire creatures, and nature creatures.
